critical_code_review_comments: delivery_scheduling.delivery_slots multiplies lead time when computing window start: start = ceil(max(now+lead, opening+lead)). Per spec 'valid windows must start no earlier than restaurant opening plus lead time / current time plus lead time' — this appears correct (lead is added to opening AND to now). Verified via unit test freezing now=12:00 Monday, 10:00-22:00 hours: first slot >= 12:40. No issue.

server.py kitchen_orders query uses $or with kitchen_release_at <= now OR scheduled_delivery_start missing/null OR kitchen_decision in accepted/declined. This correctly hides pending scheduled orders whose kitchen_release_at is still in the future. Verified read-only against live kitchen list (no leaks).
TabletStaffCreate response now correctly strips _id and password_hash (matches note about the earlier serialization fix).

MenuItemCard renders removable_ingredients only inside the 'Configure' expanded state (hasConfig turns on when removable_ingredients has entries). This is a discoverability nuance — item cards without formats/variants but with removable ingredients now require an extra 'Configure' click before customers see 'Sans <ingredient>' options. Confirmed working end-to-end but flag as UX consideration.
/tablet uses same MenuItemCard with compact prop — no menu photos rendered (0 tags found).
